info.cls_ename: Bachelor's Program of International Business Administration in English

description.describe_ch: 本課程將介紹供應鏈管理的基本概念與營運模式，並介紹供應鏈管理經營管理上所面臨的問題，以及處理這些問題的方法。課程內容包含供應鏈管理策略、物流網路設計、生產規劃、倉儲、配銷、資訊、績效評量與協同模式之推行。
description.describe_eh: This course will introduce the basic concepts and operating models of supply chain management, and introduce the problems faced by supply chain management, as well as the methods to deal with these problems. The course content includes supply chain management strategy, logistics network design, production planning, warehousing, distribution, information, performance evaluation and the implementation of collaborative models.
